_comment: Upstream-style profile: Shairport Sync over ALSA SPDIF/TOSLINK to YAS-207.
Wired logical inputs on the YAS-207 are: analog, hdmi, tv.
The logical tv input covers any TV-source audio: physical optical/TOSLINK
(this profile) and HDMI ARC (the TV HDMI OUT (ARC) jack). Both physical
routes map to the same logical tv input on the soundbar.
Mirrors the original wejn.org blog post design.
Requires no Sendspin adapter; uses the upstream shairport integration scripts
in adapters/shairport/ with shairport-sync.conf run_this_* directives.
